title: Balanced parentheses, brackets, and braces
prompt: Write a Java method `public static boolean isBalanced(String s)` that returns true if the input string has balanced parentheses (), brackets [], and braces {} in the correct nesting order, and false otherwise. Ignore non-bracket characters. Explain the time and space complexity and include a short example of usage.

title: Diagnose HTTP 403 with JWT authentication
prompt: A Spring Boot REST API uses Spring Security with JWT authentication. Authenticated users receive HTTP 403 Forbidden when calling `GET /api/orders`, even though they have a valid token. List the most likely root causes, how to diagnose each one (logs/config/code to inspect), and concrete fixes. Include common issues around roles/authorities, request matchers, CSRF, filters, and token claims.

title: Reusable paginated user component
prompt: Create a reusable React + TypeScript component for displaying a paginated list of users fetched from a REST API. Requirements: typed props/state, loading and error states, page navigation, configurable page size, and clean separation of concerns. Provide example code and briefly explain key design decisions.

title: Highest-paid employee in each department including ties
prompt: Given tables `employees(id, name, department_id, salary)` and `departments(id, name)`, write a SQL query to return the highest-paid employee(s) in each department, including ties. Return department name, employee name, and salary. Explain why your approach handles ties correctly and mention any DBMS-specific considerations if relevant.

title: Music streaming backend architecture
prompt: Design a music streaming platform backend using Spring Boot, ASP.NET Core, React, and SQL Server. Describe the high-level architecture, service boundaries, key APIs, data storage approach, authentication/authorization, scalability considerations, and how the frontend integrates. Include trade-offs and a pragmatic MVP vs. future evolution path.
